name: Menu Stats Bar
author: jlai
description: iStat-style CPU, memory, disk, and temperature monitor with sparklines and a detail popup.

barWidget.description: CPU, memory, disk, and temperature with per-metric sparklines and a click-through detail panel.

schema.label: History samples
schema.description: Samples kept per metric; the graphs show this window.

schema.label: CPU alert (%)
schema.description: Tint the CPU metric above this usage. 0 disables the alert.

schema.label: Memory alert (%)
schema.description: Tint the memory metric above this usage. 0 disables the alert.

schema.label: Disk alert (%)
schema.description: Tint the disk metric above this usage. 0 disables the alert.

schema.label: Temperature alert (°C)
schema.description: Tint the temperature metric above this reading. 0 disables the alert.
